A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/Joymo

Distribution layer, club and viewer split · adjacent platform

JoymoPremium

Oslo, Norway · founded 2017 · active · www.joymo.tv · last verified 2026-09-19

Distribution layer, club and viewer splitSoftware onlyNo Italian presence foundEvidence BViewer pays

Joymo is a Norwegian OTT platform for grassroots and federation sport that lets clubs stream from a phone, encoder or camera and sell access to viewers with safeguarding controls built in joymo-01, joymo-02.

For County FAs, schools, universities and governing bodies in the UK and Norway that want a branded, paywalled channel with consent tooling for filming minors joymo-02, joymo-03. It suits organisations that prioritise safeguarding and control over maximum reach joymo-02.

Joymo exists because grassroots bodies wanted the revenue of streaming without the exposure of public platforms, so it built a controlled-access OTT product with GDPR training, consent templates and overview framing as part of the offer joymo-02. It matters now because Spiideo, an automated camera vendor, is its largest shareholder at 18.8 percent and its partner for a UK education bundle since July 2025, which shows camera companies buying their way into the distribution layer joymo-04, joymo-05. It tells you the distribution platforms next to this category are small, loss-making and being absorbed into camera vendors' ecosystems, with Joymo posting a NOK 17 million pre-tax loss on NOK 9.7 million revenue in 2025 joymo-06.

Price band Free for the club to join in county FA deals; minimum pay-per-view ticket £3.99; club keeps 55 percent of gross profit after payment fees, VAT and streaming costs joymo-03

Italy Joymo's public partnerships are in the UK, Norway and international federations such as World Boxing, and no Italian partner or Italian-language offer was found joymo-01, joymo-07.

The verdict

Look if You are a UK county FA, school or federation that needs a paywalled channel with built-in safeguarding, consent tooling and no viewer geo-restrictions, and you can accept a 55/45 split of gross profit joymo-02, joymo-03. You should also look if you already run Spiideo cameras, since the two companies sell a combined education package and Spiideo is Joymo's largest shareholder joymo-04, joymo-05.

Skip if You need a partner with financial staying power, since Joymo lost NOK 17.1 million before tax on NOK 9.7 million revenue in 2025 and its loss ratio worsened from the prior year joymo-06. You should also skip it if your audience is outside the UK and Norway, since the company's partnerships and support are concentrated there joymo-01, joymo-07.

Watch-outs

  • The 55/45 split is on gross profit, defined after payment processing fees, VAT, taxes and streaming data costs, so the club's cash share of a £3.99 ticket is well below 55 percent of the headline price joymo-03.
  • The Lancashire FA FAQ that sets out these terms dates from the 2021 partnership and Joymo's current FAQ pages do not publish prices, so verify current terms before signing joymo-03, joymo-08.
  • Spiideo AB holds 18.81 percent of Joymo, which creates a dependency on one camera vendor's strategy for the platform's future joymo-04.
  • Joymo AS reported revenue of NOK 9.7 million and a pre-tax loss of NOK 17.1 million for 2025 with equity of NOK 6.9 million, which leaves under six months of losses in reserve at that rate joymo-06.

Company

Ownership and funding Joymo AS, org. no. 916 959 311, is registered at Torggata 35, Oslo, was founded in late 2017 and is led by CEO Mike Emery joymo-01, joymo-06. The shareholder register lists Spiideo AB as the largest owner at 18.81 percent, Investinor Indirekte II at 17.30 percent, Reodor AS at 9.36 percent and Blommenholm Industrier at 7.91 percent, among 71 owners joymo-04.

Financials Revenue of NOK 9.75 million in 2025 with a pre-tax loss of NOK 17.14 million, equity of NOK 6.86 million and total assets of NOK 9.42 million; profitability ratio fell to minus 172.8 percent from minus 112.9 percent in 2024 joymo-06.

Scale, company-stated No company-stated user, stream or partner counts were found on Joymo's pages as of September 2026 joymo-01.
